_what: Local jobs an owner may run NOW or AT A TIME from chat (scripts/jobs.py, the `job` tool). Each is a fixed command with named values; Sage posts a card (exec kind `local`, op = the key, send_at = the time) and the owner's tap runs it through drain. The registry is the allow-list: nothing outside it can be launched. Add a job here, never in code. {placeholders} come from `vars` or the job's `args`; `options` are appended only when that value is given.

jobs.name: Editor handoff build
jobs.what: package a wedding for the remote editor (editor-handoff skill): 1080p proxies, audio, reference render, READ ME, straight into Dropbox; hours of rendering, best overnight

args.couple: the couple as the Resolve project names them, e.g. Sloane & Bram

jobs.name: Editor handoff return
jobs.what: bring the editor's returned Resolve project back: every clip online, his timelines added to the live project under his name

args.couple: the couple as the Resolve project names them
args.drp: full path of the .drp he sent back

jobs.name: Bank login purge
jobs.what: delete every bank or credit union login from the doer's login vault (Recycle Bin too), keep the ones in `keep`, then say in chat what went, how many are left and where plain copies still sit (paths only); no model, nothing sent

jobs.name: Publish the template update
jobs.what: push the template checkout (core_sync.json core_root) to its public repository and cut a release, after every privacy gate (audit, people, history) and the template's tests pass again at the tap; nothing is pushed when one fails

jobs.name: Shoot-day app build
jobs.what: build the ONE Shoot Day phone app (every wedding in apps/shoot-day/weddings/ inside; it opens on today's or the next wedding by itself); with deploy=yes publish it too
aliases: build the app for the wedding

jobs.name: Shoot-day agent start
jobs.what: start the day-of agent for one wedding now (alerts + chat inside the shoot-day app); the spine starts it by itself on the wedding day

jobs.name: ShareGrid gear hold
jobs.what: put the gear packed for one wedding on hold on ShareGrid (the day before, the day and the day after) - the doer blocks the dates on the owner's listings

jobs.name: Batteries charged / used
jobs.what: record a battery group as charged or used in the gear inventory (gear/batteries.json): groups canon, nikon, npf, v-mount, neewer, smallrig, rode-go, rode-pro, aa

jobs.name: Memory card state
jobs.what: record a memory card's state in the gear inventory (gear/media.json): ready, shot, offloaded or verified; `gear/gear.py media` lists the cards and their serials

jobs.name: Memory card scan
jobs.what: learn every card's state from the card-ingest manifests on the storage drives (which cards were offloaded and verified, which were cleared)
